title: Huione Group laundering network
summary: Huione Group is a Phnom Penh-based financial conglomerate that FinCEN called a critical node for laundering proceeds of North Korean cyber heists and Southeast Asian pig-butchering scams. FinCEN issued a section 311 final rule on 14 October 2025 cutting it off from the US financial system. Its Telegram marketplace Huione Guarantee rebranded as Haowang Guarantee in October 2024. In June 2026 the US DOJ seized a cloud account used to run the marketplace, which it said hosted channels including procurement of individuals for human trafficking schemes and laundering of scam proceeds.
